title: Questions tab closes once its question is answered and the previous tab comes back; chat header stays one line when narrow
steps: S1: Run the ask-form controller tests: an answered request closes only its own session's Questions tab in dsh's column and focuses the tab that was active before it opened; a request of another session leaves this session's tabs alone.
S2: Run the header layout e2e of tracy-model-plan: the real dsh header with the job control and model chip at 800/400/300/220px in light and dark, with 1 and 12 jobs.
expect: S1: all ask-form tests pass, including the two close-and-return cases.
S2: the job control is one line (height <= 32px) at every width, shows a count badge at 400px and below, and the model chip truncates at 300px and hides only at 220px.
evidence: 21/10/2026 local cluster: the Questions tab stayed open after Send answer; the narrow header wrapped '1 background job' one word per line
fence: The ask controller's close-and-return on a settled request, and the header CSS container queries measured in Chromium
